title: Morning review Oct 30: stay defensive, orders on file
journal: Book ~$542, almost 100% in USDC. The brain's 'defensive' regime makes sense: SOL (~$95) and BTC (~$77K) are below their 20-day averages and only 3 of 21 large memecoins are above theirs. Sleeves are under target on purpose: majors (10%) and established memes (10%) only buy when the asset is above its 20-day average, and nothing qualifies; picks (20%) need a dated catalyst plus a clean anti-rug check, and today the anti-rug data provider (Helius) hit its usage cap, so no picks are bought until it is back (the check now returns NO_DATA instead of a false 'clean'). The tested turtle system has orders on file and is close to triggering: it will short ETH below $2,227 and SOL below $94.81 (2x, 1% of the book at risk per trade). No manual trades today.
